name: github-review-requests
title: GitHub Review Requests
description: Search GitHub review requests, track replies and activity, and see actionable pull requests in the menu bar.
author: resessh

commands.name: index
commands.title: Search Review Requests
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Search review requests on GitHub and listing them.

commands.name: actionablePullRequests
commands.title: My Pull Requests
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: See your GitHub pull requests at a glance

preferences.name: menuBarLayout
preferences.title: Menu Bar Layout
preferences.description: Keep the original review-status groups or show requests needing your review and reply.

preferences.name: menuBarCategory
preferences.title: Menu Bar Shows
preferences.description: Which category drives the menu bar count.

preferences.name: menuBarLimit
preferences.title: Pull Requests Shown Inline
preferences.description: How many to list directly in the menu before the rest move into a “more” submenu.

preferences.name: hideWhenEmpty
preferences.title: Menu Bar Icon
preferences.label: Hide when there is nothing to review
preferences.description: Remove the menu bar item entirely when the count is zero.

commands.name: pull-requests
commands.title: Pull Request Attention
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Browse the PRs that need your attention, grouped into colour-coded categories and saved filters.

commands.name: activity
commands.title: Activity Inbox
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Read the comments and replies the background watcher picked up, newest first, whether or not a banner fired.

commands.name: watch
commands.title: Watch for Activity
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Check for new PR activity. Enable scheduled tracking in extension preferences to record activity every ten minutes.

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Configure Review Tracking
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Choose organizations, watched repositories and teams, ignore bot authors, and manage saved filters.

preferences.name: authMethod
preferences.title: Authentication Method
preferences.description: PAT preserves the existing setup. GitHub CLI reuses your gh login and its existing organization access; it does not bypass SSO or organization policies.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Used only when Authentication Method is Personal Access Token. Existing PAT users can keep their token; authorize it for SSO organizations where required.

preferences.name: owners
preferences.title: Organizations/Owners
preferences.description: Please specify the organizations or owners to include, separated by commas.
preferences.placeholder: (Optional) Leave empty to get all owners.

preferences.name: ghPath
preferences.title: GitHub CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the GitHub CLI binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (Homebrew, /usr/local/bin, PATH).

preferences.name: host
preferences.title: GitHub Host
preferences.description: Use a GitHub Enterprise hostname to talk to a self-hosted instance. Defaults to github.com.

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Max Results Per Category
preferences.description: How many pull requests to load per category. Higher values cost more GitHub API quota.

preferences.name: trackingEnabled
preferences.title: Background Activity Tracking
preferences.label: Check for new activity every ten minutes
preferences.description: Opt in to populate the activity inbox in the background. Desktop notifications are configured separately and default to off.
